before: Compose writes the grid record of a height's own row anchor with no room record, and a checkpoint's open read that grid record as a table record of the height.
after: A checkpoint marks that grid record as drawn (the existing oc:drawn attribute) and its open takes such a record off, as it takes off drawn properties; a grid record the room holds carries no mark and stays.
reason: Change messages, the change log, the manifest fields and the Yjs format do not change: every client composes the same table from the same items, and the checkpoint attribute is one the format already has. A room admits only clients of its own code version.
